name: Alingsås HK

crest.note: Round AHK crest, blue/light-blue with white; matches the shirt family.

description: Royal-blue shirt with a lighter blue/white patterned upper body and sleeves (Kempa). Away shirt is white with blue patterned shoulders.

evidence.observation: Official club home-match banner 'Alingsås HK - IK Sävehof, 14 Nov, Estrad Alingsås': men's player in blue shirt with lighter blue patterned sleeves. Image is colour-graded blue, so hex is approximate.
Skövde-Alingsås 26-29 at Arena Skövde: Alingsås (away) in white shirt with blue details. Shows the away kit, not home.
Club result graphic (Skövde 26-29 AHK, away): men's player #11 in white shirt with blue geometric shoulders (#1C346A) = away kit.

notes: Club domains ahk.nu / alingsashk.se failed; club runs on alingsashk.myclub.se. No in-game home match photo of the men found; home evidence is the official home-match promo banner. Women's team photo on the same site shows a blue Kempa home shirt too. Do not use the white kit seen in the Skövde reports.
reviewReason: Home colour from an official, colour-graded promo banner rather than a live match photo; hex approximate.
